mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and sodium depletion, while captopril increases potassium retention through aldosterone inhibition; combined effect increases risk of electrolyte imbalance, hypotension, and acute renal dysfunction.
action: Monitor serum potassium, sodium, creatinine, and blood pressure regularly; this combination is commonly used but requires baseline and periodic laboratory assessment; adjust doses if electrolyte abnormalities or renal function decline occurs.
